stage: EDA review and feature decisions only; no revised candidate has been trained by this reviewer
data_source: Original ASTRA-SHIELD longitudinal synthetic dataset only
review_observation_scope: Training EDA charts and training summaries; no test.csv or validation metrics opened for these decisions

feature_decisions.rationale: Preserve absolute recent sleep duration; relative change alone can hide a short sleep episode.
Retain a distinct sleep opportunity/continuity indicator; bounded percent, not a generic z-score.
Retain a distinct sleep-onset indicator available before cutoff.
Retain discrete sleep-interruption information; observed skew alone is not an error or a reason to delete counts.
Retain signed timing deviation for the circadian monitoring objective; negative means earlier, not invalid.
Reduced representation uses current HR minus the fixed personal HR baseline; absolute HR remains in the full candidate.
Reduced representation uses current RMSSD minus the fixed personal RMSSD baseline; absolute RMSSD remains in the full candidate.
Reduced representation uses percent change from fixed personal reaction-time baseline, with lapse count and attention accuracy retained.
Retain discrete cognitive-response lapses alongside baseline-relative median response time.
Retain a separate accuracy domain, not a duplicated raw correct count.
Retain the current custom stress report as an available behavioral input; it is not a psychiatric diagnosis.
Retain current fatigue as a valid available predictor for tomorrow; explicitly compare a persistence baseline. It is not the future target or KSS.
Retain the current custom mood report as a complementary behavioral input.
Retain daily workload context rather than inferring it from sleep/cognitive variables.
Retain distinct daily exercise context; no target-based ranking was used to delete it.
Retain fixed calibration sleep level so absolute sleep can be interpreted alongside the individual reference.
Stable individual HR level contributes to the correlated absolute HR block; its information is used to compute HR delta before prediction.
Stable individual RMSSD level is used to compute HRV delta before prediction, rather than being a separate reduced-model predictor.
Used in the causal percent-change feature before prediction rather than as a separate reduced-model predictor.
Training Pearson r=0.919637 with absolute sleep duration; reduced candidate keeps absolute duration plus fixed sleep baseline and past-only mean, avoiding this redundant derived predictor.
Retain the project-required personal-baseline HR change in original bpm units.
Retain the project-required personal-baseline RMSSD change in milliseconds.
Retain relative cognitive slowing/speeding versus a fixed earlier baseline, preserving the personalized objective.
Retain a strictly past-only sleep summary for persistent sleep patterns, excluding today and future days.
Training Pearson r=0.892748 with fixed HR baseline; omitting this absolute history summary reduces stable-person-level redundancy in the relative-physiology sensitivity candidate.
Omitted in the compressed candidate to avoid mixing absolute reaction-time history with its retained relative-change representation; the full candidate preserves this potentially useful history.

feature_engineering_contract.baseline: Seven fixed earlier calibration days per virtual participant; never recalculated from future outcomes or full mission history
feature_engineering_contract.changes: Existing current-minus-baseline HR/RMSSD and 100*(current reaction time/baseline reaction time - 1)
feature_engineering_contract.history: Existing three-day means contain t-3,t-2,t-1 only
feature_engineering_contract.measurement_burden_note: Reduced predictor count does not remove baseline measurement requirements; raw values and fixed baseline means remain necessary to calculate relative features before serving.

predeclared_model_comparison.class_imbalance_handling: RF balanced class weights and XGBoost balanced training sample weights; no full-dataset resampling
predeclared_model_comparison.preprocessing: Train-fitted defensive median imputer only; no global scaling and no validation/test-derived statistics
predeclared_model_comparison.selection: Four candidates: two feature sets x two algorithms, compared using validation Macro-F1; report all per-class precision/recall and candidate scores
predeclared_model_comparison.hyperparameter_search: Use the already specified small candidate recipes; do not expand search after seeing validation/test results
predeclared_model_comparison.test_policy: Previously evaluated test participants are excluded from this revised development experiment. Report validation only; no claim of fresh unseen-test generalization.
predeclared_model_comparison.deployment_policy: Do not automatically replace the delivered initial API artifact based solely on development scores. Preserve its historical test report and label any new model development-only until independently evaluated.

eda_based_actions.decision: Use Macro-F1 and per-class metrics; report majority and persistence baselines; keep original participant partitions

eda_based_actions.finding: No missing/nonfinite values or failed documented engineering bounds; no duplicate row/day keys
eda_based_actions.decision: Retain all prepared training rows unchanged; no invented cleaning or imputation of already complete cells

eda_based_actions.finding: HR histogram has a right tail; other reviewed histograms are bounded simulator distributions
eda_based_actions.decision: Do not delete tail rows solely for being uncommon; trees do not require normality and synthetic tails may be intentionally generated

eda_based_actions.finding: Sleep duration versus sleep delta r=0.919637; fixed HR baseline versus prior HR mean r=0.892748
eda_based_actions.decision: Prespecify a reduced relative-feature representation as a sensitivity candidate; retain full26 as the comparison because correlation alone does not prove irrelevance

eda_based_actions.finding: Repeated daily measurements from 84 people are correlated observations
eda_based_actions.decision: Preserve participant grouping; do not treat repeated IDs as duplicates or random-split their days

limitations: Training EDA describes an engineering simulator, not measured human physiology or clinical risk.
Input-only correlation does not establish future predictive importance or causal effects.
The reduced17 set is a predeclared hypothesis, not a claim that its dropped features are medically irrelevant.
Current custom fatigue is allowed for a next-day target; all future target columns and target-derived annotations remain forbidden predictors.
No real KSS, undefined SP, V3 target, additional participant history or sensor measurements were invented.
